data.description:
# Intake Brief — Coin and Reputation should count up/down (MS-0MUYAESVU007X2U8)

## Problem statement

During the end-of-turn reconciliation, coins and reputation fly from the business cards to the HUD totals line. The HUD totals currently stay frozen at the pre-animation value for the whole choreography (the deferred window, CG-0MTR72P14000VO6Q) and then **jump** to the new value the moment the animations complete. The player therefore never sees the totals building as the coins/reputation arrive. This item makes the HUD totals animate in step with the reconciliation: they count **up** while receiving coins/reputation and **down** when losing, with the counting happening as the coin/pip flights play.

## Users

- **Main Street player (single-player)** — sees their coins and reputation totals climb/fall in step with the coin and pip flights arriving at the HUD at the end of the turn, making the reconciliation legible and satisfying.
- **Game designer** — gets a glanceable read of the end-of-turn income/expense reconciling against the HUD.
- **Developer / QA** — needs the counting to be display-only and deterministic: it must not alter any state, economy, or deferred-mutation invariant.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC1 — Counts during the reconciliation.** While the end-of-turn deferred window is active (`incomeCollectionActive`), the HUD "Coins:" total is animated: it steps up as coin flights land at the HUD (the grid-to-HUD collection and any gain flights to the HUD counter), and reaches the post-reconciliation value **exactly** when the last such flight lands. The "Reputation:" total behaves identically for reputation pips.
- **AC2 — Symmetric count-down.** When the end-of-turn reconciliation reflects a loss (coins and/or reputation decrease, e.g. incident or negative upcoming delta with HUD→card flights), the HUD totals count **down** symmetrically as the flights depart from the HUD, ending exactly at the final value.
- **AC3 — Reduced motion, replay and headless unchanged.** Under reduced motion and in replay/headless modes the totals render the final value directly with no counting animation (the existing deferred-path fallbacks are untouched).
- **AC4 — Display-only; invariants preserved.** The counting never mutates `state`, `previousCoins`/`previousReputation`, the exactly-once deferred-delta application (`endOfTurnDeltasApplied` / `applyPendingDeltasOnce`), or any economy/transitional value. The final `refreshAll()` after the window closes still shows the authoritative post-delta values.
- **AC5 — Tests.** Automated coverage asserts: (a) a mid-flight displayed total is strictly between the pre- and post-reconciliation values, (b) the total equals the final value at the last landing, (c) losses count down, and (d) reduced motion never counts. Existing income-collection, deferred-mutation and phase-sequential tests continue to pass.
- **AC6 — Documentation.** All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.
- **AC7 — Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.**

## Constraints

- **Presentation-only** — the counting lives in the renderer/animator; it must never touch the engine or the transcript.
- **Deferred window intact** (CG-0MTR72P14000VO6Q) — `previousCoins`/`previousReputation` continue to drive the pre-animation display; the new *displayed* values are a separate, render-time quantity layered on top.
- **Reduced motion never counts** (existing convention: immediate single final pop, CG-0MTR72P14000VO6Q).
- The final displayed value must be **exact** at the last landing — no off-by-one or floating drift; rounding follows the existing integer-economy convention (`Math.round` in `refreshHud`).
- Scope is the end-of-turn reconciliation only (producer decision, see Appendix Q1); market buys, Community Favour and mid-turn deltas are out of scope.

## Existing state

- `refreshHud()` (src/scenes/MainStreetRendererHud.ts) computes the deferred window from `incomeCollectionActive`/`incidentRevealActive` and renders `previousCoins`/`previousReputation` while it is active; the value is static throughout the ~11s choreography (`animateIncomePhases`), then the window closes and `finishTurnPresentation`'s `refreshAll()` shows the post-delta values — a single jump.
- `animateHudValueChanges()` suppresses the mid-animation delta pop while `incomeCollectionActive` is true, so the only landing feedback is the final `+total` pop.
- `collectIncomeGrids()` (src/scenes/MainStreetAnimatorIncome.ts) flies the per-card coin grids to the HUD sequentially; each icon's `onComplete` decrements a `pending` counter and the last landing calls `finalize()` (applies deferred deltas exactly once via `applyPendingDeltasOnce`, then clears the window).
- Upcoming deltas fly point-to-point to/from the HUD via `flyCoinsToPoint`/`flyRepPips` (gain card→HUD, loss HUD→card); the incident reveal (MainStreetAnimatorIncident.ts) similarly flies HUD→card for losses.
- Unit tests exist for income collection and phase choreography (`tests/main-street/income-collection-animator.test.ts`, `income-phase-sequential-animator.test.ts`); browser tests cover the deferred window (`tests/main-street/main-street-animators-deferred.browser.test.ts`).

## Desired change

Introduce a display-only, per-resource *displayed total* (e.g. `displayedCoins` / `displayedReputation` on the scene) that:

1. Is initialised to the pre-animation value (`previousCoins`/`previousReputation`) when the deferred window opens.
2. Is stepped +/− as coin/pip flights **land at** (gain) or **depart from** (loss) the HUD during the reconciliation — grid-to-HUD collection, upcoming card/HUD deltas, and incident HUD→card losses — one step per icon using the icon's coin/pip value, so the running total tracks the animation and lands exactly on the final value at the last arrival.
3. Is what `refreshHud()` renders (rounded, per the integer-economy convention) in place of the static pre-animation value while the deferred window is active; outside the window `refreshHud` falls back to the existing `previousCoins`/state logic untouched.
4. Is reset/cleared after the final `refreshAll()` that closes the turn, so the next turn starts from the authoritative state.

The counting hooks live where flights already complete (the `onComplete` handlers in `collectIncomeGrids`, `flyCoinsToPoint`, `flyRepPips` and the incident-reveal flights) so no new flight choreography is introduced. Unit tests cover the stepping logic with a mocked scene; a browser test samples the HUD text mid-animation to prove the intermediate values.

## Key Files

- `src/scenes/MainStreetRendererHud.ts` — `refreshHud()`: render the display-only totals during the deferred window (replaces the static `previousCoins`/`previousReputation` readout while counting).
- `src/scenes/MainStreetAnimatorIncome.ts` — step `displayedCoins`/`displayedReputation` at flight landings/departures (`collectIncomeGrids`, `flyCoinsToPoint`, `flyRepPips`).
- `src/scenes/MainStreetAnimatorIncident.ts` — step the displayed totals for incident-reveal HUD→card loss flights.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetScene.ts` — new display-state fields + reset conventions (`createScene`, lifecycle).
- `src/scenes/MainStreetTurnControllerTurnFlow.ts` — initialise displayed totals at `endTurn()` alongside `previousCoins` capture; ensure the displayed values are cleared after the final refresh.
- `tests/main-street/income-collection-animator.test.ts` — unit coverage of the stepping logic.
- `tests/main-street/main-street-animators-deferred.browser.test.ts` — browser coverage of mid-flight intermediate values and exact final landing.

## Related work

- `Visual representation of reputation (MS-0MTV9AS15004AC1E)` — completed epic; introduced the reputation HUD counter and on-street population.
- `Reputation phase dissolve-to-coins (MS-0MUYGFWXK003QFYB)` — completed; reworked the reputation income source (coins now fly from pedestrians, not the HUD counter) — the count-up applies to the collection phase that follows.
- `Perform end of turn phase for each player (MS-0MUXAQQON006XA6I)` — completed; per-seat end-of-turn phases.
- CG-0MTR72P14000VO6Q — "Don't add coins/reputation/score until the end of the end of turn cycle" (deferred window; the display-only count-up is a refinement of, and dependent on, this window).
- CG-0MUA1UH3A008M4BS — Upcoming coin/reputation delta flights to/from the HUD (source of the gain/loss flight directions used by the counting).

## Risks & assumptions

- **Risk (scope creep):** tempting to animate mid-turn HUD changes (market buys, Community Favour) for consistency — out of scope by producer decision (Q1); record as a future work item, not scope.
- **Risk (animation cost):** counting inside `onComplete` per icon adds negligible cost but must stay robust if a flight is destroyed or skipped; the final value must still resolve via the existing `pending`/`finalize` path.
- **Risk (floating drift):** per-icon increments are fractional; use exact accumulation (e.g. set the displayed total to the slot total when the slot's last icon lands, or accumulate with the same `roundHalf` used by the economy) to guarantee the final exactness in AC1/AC2.
- **Risk (regression):** the deferred window (`previousCoins` semantics, CG-0MTR72P14000VO6Q) and reduced-motion/replay exemptions are heavily covered by existing tests; any change must keep `income-collection-animator`, `income-phase-sequential-animator` and `main-street-animators-deferred` suites green.
- **Assumption:** the count-up applies to the *collection* phase only (as coins/reputation animate from the business card to the HUD at the end of the cycle — Q1); competitive per-seat wallets are unchanged.
- **Assumption:** the displayed number is rounded to whole coins/reputation as today (`Math.round`).

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

- Q1: "Scope of the count-up/down — end-of-turn reconciliation only, or all HUD changes?" — Answer (producer): "As the coins/reputation are animating from the business card to the HUD status line at the end of the cycle" → **end-of-turn reconciliation only** (the collection flights to the HUD). Source: interactive reply (2026-10-14). Research: `refreshHud` deferred window renders only during `incomeCollectionActive`/`incidentRevealActive`; mid-turn changes are out of scope. Related: CG-0MTR72P14000VO6Q.
- Q2: "Per-flight landing step or smooth tween?" — Answer (producer): **A — per-flight landing** (total steps as each coin/pip arrives at the HUD, reaching the final value exactly when the last one lands). Source: interactive reply (2026-10-14). Research: `collectIncomeGrids` per-icon `onComplete` counts down `pending`; the natural hook already exists.
- Q3: "Negative deltas / reduced motion?" — Answer (producer): **A — symmetric count-down; reduced motion jumps straight to the final value**. Source: interactive reply (2026-10-14). Research: existing reduced-motion convention skips flights and keeps the single final pop (CG-0MTR72P14000VO6Q); an instant final render preserves that.
